steps.en: Call the forge with a behavior direction and a layer range
steps.zh: 带着行为方向与层区间调用 forge

steps.en: Installs an ablation or addition layer on the chosen decoder layers
steps.zh: 在选定的解码层上挂消融或增强层

steps.en: Scores refusal expressions in the generated responses
steps.zh: 给生成回复里的拒答表达打分

steps.en: Save or push the transformed model
steps.zh: 保存或推送改造后的模型

value.en: A model whose decoder layers are edited to ablate or amplify a chosen behavior
value.zh: 一个解码层被改造过、能消融或放大某种行为的模型
